hackathons.name: MediMitra
hackathons.organizer: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 – PS ID: SIH25049
hackathons.description: Built an AI-powered multilingual healthcare assistant with WhatsApp Business API integration and n8n workflow automation, using Gemini and MongoDB, for a national government problem statement.
hackathons.challenge: Public health awareness in rural communities limited by low internet bandwidth and lack of medical app adoption.
hackathons.role: Team Lead & AI Architect — designed the n8n workflow automation and multilingual Gemini NLU pipeline.
hackathons.outcome: Selected among Top 30 college finalists for Smart India Hackathon software-track submission.

hackathons.name: Analytix'26 Datathon
hackathons.description: Analyzed complex datasets and presented actionable insights as a team under competitive 24-hour datathon constraints.
hackathons.challenge: Filtering raw unstructured data for accuracy under strict time and validation constraints.
hackathons.role: Data Pipeline & Visualization Lead — performed Python/Pandas cleaning and statistical modeling.
hackathons.outcome: High-signal analytical dashboards surfacing reliable operational insights.

hackathons.name: Edith – AI Agent Buildathon
hackathons.description: Built an AI agent solution under 12-hour time constraints enabling automated conversational workflows and order tracking.
hackathons.challenge: Store owners struggle with complex inventory dashboards and manual order tracking.
hackathons.role: Full-Stack AI Engineer — integrated Telegram Bot API with n8n workflow automation.
hackathons.outcome: Fully functioning AI agent processing real-time stock queries and automating supplier reorders.

awards.title: Smart India Hackathon Software Finalist
awards.description: Recognized as a top 30 team nationally at SIH 2025 for MediMitra.
